leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply TypeScript interfaces to define the structure of API response data with explicit typing.
Use React's useState hook to initialize and manage component state for tracking API request status.
Implement a cleanup function with AbortController to cancel pending fetch requests when components unmount.
Execute conditional rendering to display loading indicators while API requests are in progress.
Utilize the useEffect hook with dependency arrays to control when API requests are triggered.
Construct async/await functions to handle asynchronous API calls within React components.
Define error handling logic to catch and display fetch errors in the user interface.
Apply the optional chaining operator (?.) to safely access nested properties in API response data.
Control component re-renders by properly managing state updates within asynchronous callbacks.
Implement a race condition prevention pattern by storing and comparing request identifiers.
Modify component cleanup to abort fetch requests using the AbortController's signal property.
Return appropriate UI components based on the current state of the API request lifecycle.
